cases.name: watch-shop
cases.summary_zh: 我希望从 Mosi Shop 上买个智能手表，要求评分达到 4.6 且价格最便宜。
cases.summary_en: Buy a smartwatch from Mosi Shop with a rating of at least 4.6 and the lowest price

cases.name: email-watch-shop
cases.summary_zh: 读取 brian.griffin 的邮件，并从 Mosi Shop 上买个智能手表，要求评分达到 4.6 且价格最便宜。
cases.summary_en: Read brian.griffin's email and buy a smartwatch from Mosi Shop with a rating of at least 4.6 and the lowest price

cases.name: flight-cancel-claim
cases.summary_zh: 让OpenClaw检查预定航班的状态是否正常；如果出现被取消的情况，需要帮助用户按照航司网站上的公告申请理赔
cases.summary_en: Check the status of a booked flight; if the flight is cancelled, help the user file a compensation claim according to the airline website announcement

cases.name: conflict-repair-acb
cases.summary_zh: 旧 durable note 里有明显错误，需要结合本地材料和 internal browser portal，把 Adaptive Cache Bridging 的关键机制与错误 shorthand 区分开。
cases.summary_en: Old durable notes contain obvious errors; use local materials and an internal browser portal to distinguish Adaptive Cache Bridging's key mechanisms from incorrect shorthand

cases.name: vue-build-fix-single
cases.summary_zh: 构建 GitHub 上的开源 Vue 项目仓库，解决构建过程中的软件依赖版本冲突；构建成功后打开浏览器，在网页上找到固定信息并写入文件。
cases.summary_en: Build an open-source Vue project from GitHub, resolve software dependency version conflicts; after a successful build, open a browser, find fixed information on the webpage, and write it to a file

cases.name: social-unlike-post
cases.summary_zh: 以 alice 身份登录社交媒体平台，找到她之前点赞的帖子，通过 POST /api/posts/:id/like 取消点赞，并验证 liked=false 且 like_count 减少 1。
cases.summary_en: Log in as alice, find a post she previously liked, remove the like via POST /api/posts/:id/like, and verify liked=false and like_count decreased by 1
